title: Base change of an indexed coproduct of copies of a scheme
statement: Let $U$ and $V$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $v:V\to U$ be a morphism, let $E$ be a set, and let $U_E=\coprod_{e\in E}U$ and $V_E=\coprod_{e\in E}V$ be the coproducts of copies of the schemes [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family], with codiagonals to $U$ and $V$. Then the morphism of schemes over $V$ $$V_E\longrightarrow V\times_U U_E$$ whose restriction to the $e$-th summand is the unique morphism with projections $\operatorname{id}_V:V\to V$ and $\iota_e\circ v:V\to U_E$ is an isomorphism. Under this isomorphism, the $e$-th coprojection of $V_E$ corresponds to the base change of the $e$-th coprojection of $U_E$.

source.place: Schemes, Lemmas Tags 01JB and 01JC (lemma-glue and lemma-glue-schemes), applied to the coproduct family after base change, with the universal property of fibre products in Section 26.17

proof.text: Let c be the codiagonal of the coproduct of copies of U and j_e the pullback lift with projections identity and v followed by the e-th coprojection. Base change the coproduct open cover using Mathlib Scheme.Pullback.openCoverOfRight. Its e-th source is pullback v (Sigma.ι e ≫ c). Since Sigma.ι e ≫ c is the identity, construct an explicit isomorphism a_e from V to this source, with inverse pullback.fst; both inverse identities follow from pullback.hom_ext and pullback.condition. The equations of pullback.map show j_e = a_e.hom followed by the e-th cover map. Thus all j_e are open immersions and their images cover the pullback.

The ranges of j_e and j_e' are disjoint for distinct indices: apply pullback.snd to any purported common point and use the disjointness of the coprojections, in Lean sigmaι_eq_iff. Mathlib isOpenImmersion_sigmaDesc then makes Sigma.desc j an open immersion. This criterion follows from the cited image-isomorphism and gluing statements: put O = ⋃ e, range(j_e); identify each V with its open image using lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-iso-onto-image, and glue the inverses followed by the coprojections V → ∐ V over the disjoint open cover of O using lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing. The overlaps for distinct indices are empty, and the two composites are identities by gluing uniqueness and the coproduct universal property. Thus ∐ V → O is an isomorphism and its composite with O → pullback v c is an open immersion. Every point of the pullback comes from some component of the base-changed open cover; use a_e.inv to give its preimage in V and then the e-th coprojection into the coproduct of copies of V. Hence the range of Sigma.desc j is top. Apply isIso_of_isOpenImmersion_of_opensRange_eq_top, the full-image case of the open-immersion image isomorphism. Finally the displayed restriction equality is Sigma.ι_desc.
